agent_notes: The NIRF government listing contains the exact assigned institution name with Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh.

The official About page describes ABESIT as self-financed and gives AKTU College Code 290, which conflicts with the supplied institution_type government_college metadata; the identity and city otherwise match.

The official catalogue is incomplete and inconsistent: /courses/ lists four B.Tech entries and has empty sections for IoT, Electronics and Communication Engineering, MCA and Applied Sciences; the current 2026-27 /admission/ table lists CSE, CSE (AI), CSE (Data Science), BBA and BCA but omits Information Technology, while the homepage lists Information Technology and separate official pages identify MCA.

The official course page calls BBA 'Bachelor of Business Application', while the current 2026-27 admission table calls it 'Bachelor of Business Administration'; the course-page title was retained verbatim.
B.Tech lateral entry is an admission route to the B.Tech degree rather than a separate catalogue programme and was not duplicated as a separate course.

The homepage links a separate College of Pharmacy at https://pharmacy.abesit.edu.in/ with a different AKTU college code; its B.Pharm offering was excluded because this verification is limited to ABES Institute of Technology.

Normal TLS verification was attempted first and failed with curl error 60 ('self signed certificate in certificate chain') from the managed proxy; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected NIRF, search-engine and abesit.in hosts.
